messages:
Diego (AE): FYI customer Orbit wants to sign annual renewal but is asking for a 25% uplift discount on the committed rate. They say usage will be 3x this year due to product launch. Asking me to fast-track pricing and POC SLA details.
Priya (CS): Thanks Diego. Do we have their current committed tier and overage behavior? I remember they were on a 50M token commit with burst allowed.
Diego (AE): Correct — 50M monthly commit, they've consistently used ~18-22M on average. Forecasted uplift is mostly chat+embedding workloads.
Marcel (SalesOps): 25% is outside standard renewal uplift bands. Need Deal Desk approval. Can you paste the target ARR and requested term?
Diego (AE): They want a 12-month extension, commit moves to 180M/mo, pricing asked is current unit price * 0.75, plus a PO on 30-day payment terms. ARR delta ~ $1.2M.
Eve (Solutions Eng): On the POC side they insist on a dedicated pool for latency guarantees for the launch window. They want an SLA of 95th pct latency < 300ms and KV cache persistence across restarts. That triggers Dedicated options.
Priya (CS): Dedicated will change the commercial model — reserved capacity + minimum monthly. Also we need to run security Qs: they asked for the SOC2 attestation and a short answers doc for their questionnaire (data residency and retention).
Jo (Legal): Heads up — PO on 30-day net and 25% discount requires exec sign-off and exceptions on standard EULA terms (we usually require 45-day net for new enterprise deals). Also they flagged a Data Processing Agreement addendum.
Marcel (SalesOps): @Jo can we get a quick exception play? If we classify this as strategic (launch partner) we might approve faster. Need the margin impact calc.
Jo (Legal): Send the proposed SOW and the exact clause they want changed. If it's just payment terms and a DPA we can fast-track but need CS review on retention limits.
dealbot: New approval request created: DD-7782 for Orbit renewal — approvers: Head of Sales, Finance, Legal. Link: https://dealdesk.internal/review/DD-7782
Diego (AE): Linking POC plan: will run a 2-week dedicated capacity POC in staging -> production can be scheduled if we can provision a dedicated pool. Eve can provide sizing.
Eve (Solutions Eng): Initial sizing suggests a 2x of their forecast burst GPU footprint during launch — estimated reserved cost ~ $18k/month for a 3-month ramp. I can drop a config snippet:
```
pool: orbit-prod-boost
gpus: 4xA10G
seq_len: 2048
batching: adaptive
kv_cache_persist: true
```
Priya (CS): Orbit's security team also asked for clarifying logs retention and audit trail for inference requests — can CS get SOC2 + sample access logs?
Jo (Legal): We can provide SOC2 report under NDA. For logs we need to redact PII and define retention policy — standard is 90 days unless customer purchases extended retention.
Marcel (SalesOps): Okay, to move forward I need: 1) Finalized pricing ask in numbers, 2) POC duration and cost, 3) Any legal exceptions, 4) Margin impact. If Diego + Jo + Eve confirm we can present Deal Desk with a consolidated packet.
Diego (AE): I'll compile the numbers today. Quick ask: if we propose a structured uplift (20% discount tied to 12-month commit + 6% early-pay credit), is that easier to approve than flat 25%?
Marcel (SalesOps): Yes, structured incentives (commit tier + prepay) are more likely to be approved. Submit as 20% base + 6% prepay credit = effective 24% with better cash terms. Include renewal clause to re-evaluate at 9 months.
Jo (Legal): Also add standard security milestone clause: dedicated pool only provisioned after DPA signed and KYC completed. No special indemnities.
Priya (CS): I'll prepare a short answers doc for their security questionnaire and request SOC2 NDA. Diego — please get the PO template and target sign date.
Diego (AE): On it. Target: close by EOD Friday if Deal Desk greenlights.
Eve (Solutions Eng): I'll schedule POC provisioning window tentatively for next Wed, pending approvals.
Marcel (SalesOps): I'll open Deal Desk packet now (DD-7782) and attach preliminary finance calc. Will ping when it's up for voting. :thumbsup:
Diego (AE): Thanks team — looping in Orbit (cc: @orbit-prod) for PO and timeline confirmation.
Orbit (customer): @Diego thanks — we can do the PO as soon as pricing is finalized. Launch date is fixed so need a decision this week.
Priya (CS): Noted — prioritizing SOC2 NDA so legal can review.
Marcel (SalesOps): Deal Desk ops: please vote by 12:00 PST tomorrow. If approved we draft amendment and special SOW for Dedicated POC.
Jo (Legal): I'll review terms tonight. Ping me for any redlines.
Marcel (SalesOps): (added) Margin hit shows ~9% at the proposed effective discount. Finance is okay if we get 12-month commit and prepay.
Diego (AE): Great — will update Orbit and push for PO.
Priya (CS): I'll upload the security Q&A and SOC2 NDA link to the thread when ready.
Eve (Solutions Eng): FYI — if they need KV persistence across restarts we may need to enable persistent volumes, note added cost.
Diego (AE): Closing note: if Deal Desk declines we'll propose a compromise: 15% + 3-month free burst credit. Will keep everyone posted.
